# Anuj Patel — Applied AI & Voice AI Engineer

Anuj Patel (handle: byanujpatel) is an applied AI and Voice AI engineer based in India. He specializes in voice-first applications and conversational agents, alongside LLM applications, FastAPI backends, AI agent workflows, RAG pipelines and full-stack MVPs, with a bias for shipping working products over slide decks.

## Projects

### VANI
Voice AI agent. A specialized voice-first AI system built on Sarvam AI — users talk, ask, and get spoken answers instead of typing.
Stack: Sarvam AI, Voice, LLMs, Python.
Demo: https://x.com/byanujpatel/status/2089730103928598667
Code: https://github.com/byanujpatel/Sarvam-AI/tree/main/VANI-Project

### Smriti
Voice-first health memory and companion application designed specifically for families — tracks medications, routines, and health updates through conversation.
Stack: Voice, Memory, LLMs, Python.
Live: https://smriti-health-companion.onrender.com
Code: https://github.com/byanujpatel/Smriti-Health-Companion

### Content Repurposing Engine
AI content engine. Creators waste hours adapting one idea for each platform; this turns docs, URLs and PDFs into ready-to-post drafts across platforms in under 10 seconds per run.
Stack: Python, FastAPI, LLMs, Streamlit.
Live: https://repurposemycontent.streamlit.app
Code: https://github.com/byanujpatel/content-repurposing-engine

### TrendChain AI
Crypto trend engine. Crypto creators need timely ideas from noisy live sources; TrendChain turns YouTube, Hacker News, CoinGecko and news into viral content ideas with live signals.
Stack: Python, LLMs, CoinGecko API, Hacker News API.
Live: https://crypto-trend-finder.streamlit.app
Code: https://github.com/byanujpatel/TrendChain-AI
